blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is heading ka number “7.2.2.5” chhapa hai. Yeh 7.3.2 (Impacts of the Digital Divide) ka paanchwan hissa hai, is liye sahi number 7.3.2.5 hai.

Bara digital divide digital literacy (technology istemal karne ki samajh aur maharat) mein bhi faasla paida karta hai. Jin logon ko technology tak rasai nahi, woh zaroori digital skills nahi seekh pate, aur tech-savvy (technology mein mahir) logon aur baqi logon ka farq aur pakka ho jata hai. Yeh faasla un ki digital duniya mein achhi tarah kaam karne aur online wasail istemal karne ki salahiyat ko mutasir karta hai.

Misal: Pakistan mein jin logon ke paas computer aur internet nahi, woh digital skills seekhne aur mashq karne ke mauqe kho dete hain. Is liye un logon ke muqable mein jinhein roz technology milti hai, unhein rozmarra kaamon ke liye online tools istemal karne mein mushkil hoti hai, jaise naukri ke liye apply karna ya government services tak pohanchna.

blocks.prompt: Digital literacy ka faasla khud ba khud kyun barhta rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Rasai nahi to mashq nahi, aur mashq nahi to skills nahi banti. Skills na hon to baad mein technology mil bhi jaye to kam faida hota hai, is liye log peeche hi rehte hain aur tech-savvy logon se farq barhta hai.

items: Digital literacy gap: rasai nahi to skills nahi; naukri ki application aur sarkari services online istemal karna mushkil.
